    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    sep=[c for c,n in cnt.items() if n>=min(h,w)*(h+h//3)] and None
    # pick sep: color with count >= (h - rows_of_seps)... use full-row heuristic first: colors that fill an entire row
    sep=None

    sr=[i for i in range(h) if all(g[i][j]==sep for j in range(w))]
    hc=[j for j in range(w) if sum(1 for i in range(h) if g[i][j]==sep)>=h-h//3]
    others=[x for x in set(x for r in g for x in r) if x!=sep]
    bg=sorted(others,key=lambda x:-cnt[x])[0]; noise=others[-1]

    rs=seg(h,sr); cs=seg(w,hc)

    for a,b in rs:

from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    sep=None
    for c,n in cnt.items():
        if any(all(g[i][j]==c for j in range(w)) for i in range(h)): sep=c; break
    sr=[i for i in range(h) if all(g[i][j]==sep for j in range(w))]
    hc=[j for j in range(w) if sum(1 for i in range(h) if g[i][j]==sep)>=h-h//3]
    nb=[x for x in set(x for r in g for x in r) if x!=sep]
    bg=nb[-1] if len(nb)>2 else max(cnt,key=lambda x:cnt[x])
    # bg = most common color among non-sep
    nbkg=[x for x in nb if x != bg]
    noise=min(nbkg, key=lambda x: cnt[x]) if nbkg else None
    def seg(n,seps):
        s=[];prev=0
        for x in seps+[n]:
            if x>prev: s.append((prev,x))
            prev=x+1
        return s
    rs=seg(h,sr); cs=seg(w,hc)
    out=[]
    for a,b in rs:
        row=[]
        for c,d in cs:
            nsum=sum(1 for i in range(a,b) for j in range(c,d) if g[i][j]==noise)
            row.append(nsum-1 if nsum>1 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
